title: Video Creator (100% remote)
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY

title: QA Testers Wanted to Jump on an AI Assistant project
description:
About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)
  9. Israel (Native Hebrew speakers)
  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.
location: Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Saudi Arabia and Israel

title: Senior React Full-stack Developer
description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

We’re looking for

Senior React & Python Developers with:

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • Commercial experience in one of the following combinations:
    React.js 3+ years and Python 3+ years;
    React.js 2+ years and Python 5+ years;
    React.js 5+ years and Python 2+ years

  • Commercial experience with at least one cloud provider: AWS, GCP, or Azure

Senior React.js & Node.js Developers with:

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Commercial experience in one of the following combinations:
    React.js 3+ years and Node.js 5+ years,
    React.js 5+ years and Node.js 3+ years
  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Next.js
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript, AWS, and AI-assisted coding (required)

Senior Ruby & React Developers with:

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Commercial experience in one of the following combinations:
    React.js: 2+ years and Ruby: 5+ years
    React.js: 5+ years and Ruby: 2+ years
  • Commercial experience with at least one cloud provider: AWS, GCP, or Azure

Other requirements for all roles:

  • You own problems end-to-end: you identify issues, design and build solutions, and ship them to production
  • You can demonstrate business impact with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)
  • You have advanced (C1) English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and communicate your results clearly on client calls
  • You work full-time, fully remote, and work independently
  • You ramp up quickly and start delivering within your first few weeks

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile
  2. Verify your role
  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the Lemon.io community.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We’re placing senior tech professionals with 4+ years of commercial experience in the following roles: AI Agent Architect, AI Automation Architect, AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, MLOps, Data Analyst, Data Annotator, Data Architect, Data Engineer, Data Scientist, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer, Animator, Graphic Designer, UI/UX Designer, Project Manager, Product Manager, QA Automation Engineer, Manual QA Engineer, Back-end Developer (.NET & C#, Golang, Java & Spring, Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce, Node.js & TypeScript, PHP & Laravel, Python, Python & LLM, Python & Node.js, Ruby, Rust, TypeScript, Scala, or C++), Front-end Developer (Angular or Vue & Nuxt), Full-stack Developer (Angular & .NET, Angular & Node.js, Java & React, PHP & Angular, PHP & React, PHP & Vue, Python & Vue, React & .NET, React & Golang, React & Python & Node.js, Full-stack/Mobile Developer (React & Node.js & React Native), Svelte, Symfony with any front-end stack, Vue & .NET, or Vue & Node.js), Mobile Developer (Android, Android & iOS, Flutter, iOS & Swift, React & React Native, React Native & Node.js, React Native & Python, or React Native & Ruby), Blockchain Developer (Solana, Solidity, or Web/Blockchain), Electron Developer, Shopify Developer, WordPress Developer, Unity Developer, or Unreal Engine Developer. Reach out and we’ll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).
location: Europe, LATAM, APAC, the U.S., Canada
